item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President issues an executive directive introducing an internal governmental council provision; the segment itself does not alter substantive legal rights or dictate a later legal outcome.","evidence":"it is hereby ordered as follows"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and staffs an advisory council and directs it to promote improvements in physical-fitness programs, all matters of executive organization and discretionary coordination without a substantive legal consequence.","evidence":"There is hereby established the President's Council on Physical Fitness"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President assigns the Council coordination and outreach duties, directs departments to provide assistance as necessary, preserves existing legal functions, and declares administrative continuity; these are internal organizational and implementation measures rather than changes to legal rights.","evidence":"The Council shall seek to coordinate, stimulate, and improve the functions of Federal agencies"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately makes a housekeeping amendment to the name appearing on an executive council's seal; the amendment reorganizes administrative identification without creating a substantive legal consequence.","evidence":"is hereby amended by substituting the word \"Physical\" wherever the word \"Youth\" appears"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately revokes earlier executive orders as an internal administrative reorganization, which the codebook expressly treats as internal management rather than a substantive legal-rights change.","evidence":"are hereby revoked"}]}
